evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'I just need to ask you some questions about. It might take about ten minutes if this is a good time' — time-boxed, but no explicit promise of a dependable quote and no clear wait for affirmation before diving into probing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name asked (Peter), email asked, phone number provided by customer, address asked (840 Bells Street, Fort Worth 76052). Moving day ('tomorrow') confirmed. No explicit city-to-city route clarity (unload only, origin not asked). Approximate size: 26-foot box truck mentioned by customer at call start.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type asked (house vs apartment, single story confirmed). Rooms not directly asked. Truck fullness asked ('How full is the truck, fully packed, fifty percent?'). Oversized items asked (safe, piano, workout equipment — customer declined). Fragile items asked (glass tables, artworks). Box count asked (650 estimated). Walking distance, additional rooms, additional stops not covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes — 'Do you have an estimated number of boxes from there as well? Do you think we have around 5000?' Customer said 650.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typical range provided: 'typically a 26 foot box truck... may take three to four hours' with estimate of '$776' for four-hour scenario. Personalized to truck size and fullness.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Hourly rate ($97/mover, $194 for two movers) disclosed. 'All inclusive rates, like everything we need is already in that price.' Truck not charged separately. Two-and-a-half-hour minimum, fifteen-minute increments disclosed. Trip fee, overnight fee — not explicitly mentioned. No 'not a guess' commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moved into summary of pricing terms without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or similar, and no pause held.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Delivered: 'on time guarantee if we run late we provide discounts for your move' — discount framing present, discount terms clear.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Delivered: 'no worries damage coverage which would give you guys up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages.' Coverage amount and no-deductible/no-fine-print framing implicit in wording, though not explicitly stated as 'built into the rate, no add-on.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep listed Two Promises but did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' — no loop closure.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call ended with customer saying 'let me keep calling around cause I think that might be the most expensive' — rep did not ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or genuine final-check variant.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Customer initiated disconnect by saying he would call around.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Not applicable — no booking occurred. Customer ended call to shop other movers.

top_strength: Joanna disclosed pricing clearly and comprehensively, including hourly rates, minimum, billing increments, and all-inclusive framing — the customer had full visibility into costs and structure.
coaching_note: Skip 'Their Concerns' entirely (never asked what mattered beyond price) and never reach an ask or close — this call had no discovery of customer priorities, no 'Does that feel fair?' pause to absorb the price, and no final safety net before the customer walked to a competitor.
